evals.name: should-trigger-scheduled-story-run
evals.prompt: Nightly routine: run /autonomous-delivery story and pick the next unblocked ticket by yourself.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates autonomous-delivery in `story` mode: Phase 0 lock, Phase 1 audit (git ancestry against `<integration-branch>`, live ledger), Phase 2 select, Phase 3 dispatch /sprint-development, Phase 4 close and report. Cap 1 story.

evals.name: should-run-greenfield-unchanged
evals.prompt: Run /autonomous-delivery bug on this project scaffolded from the boilerplate (main-integration, integration: staging, stack block at its schema defaults).
evals.expected_behavior: Every ancestry and base check runs against `origin/staging` exactly as before; the live ledger is read through the DB MCP (`list_migrations`); the dispatched /sprint-development verifies with `bun run lint:check`, `bun run types:check`, `bun run test`. The migration gate is unchanged under `migrations: confirm`.

evals.name: should-not-end-the-run-on-a-null-integration-branch
evals.prompt: Run /autonomous-delivery story. git_strategy is solo-main, branches.integration is null.
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT end in Phase 0 for a missing integration branch: `<integration-branch>` resolves to `git_strategy.branches.production` for the ancestry and base checks. The dispatched ticket stops at an open PR with its preview deployment verified; the run never merges into production (that is /sprint-development Stage 5, human-gated) and says so in the report.

evals.name: should-skip-ledger-and-db-tickets-without-db-capability
evals.prompt: Run /autonomous-delivery story. No database MCP is connected in this scheduled session.
evals.expected_behavior: Phase 1 skips the live migration ledger and says so in the run report; Phase 2 does not claim a candidate whose plan would touch the schema and picks a non-database ticket instead (or reports an empty run). It never invents a ledger from a local directory listing.

evals.name: should-gate-a-prisma-migration-but-apply-it-with-the-apps-tool
evals.prompt: Unattended run, migrations: autonomous. The story adds a nullable column; stack.database.migrations_tool is prisma.
evals.expected_behavior: Additive under `autonomous`: proceeds. Reads the history through the DB MCP immediately before, applies with the app's own Prisma script (sprint-development/references/database-changes.md), never the MCP apply call, then re-reads the live definition and diffs it against the generated migration.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-interactive-named-ticket
evals.prompt: Implement UPEX-123 with me now, I'm here to answer questions.
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT activate autonomous-delivery: a human is on the line and named the ticket. Routes to /sprint-development directly.
